body: The merge batch on main `aaddb2d48` did not merge this PR. The PR conflicts with main in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`: main and this PR both changed the `definition` and `holder` descriptions of the add-tool MCP tool (main added the Weldon holder pick). The resolution needs a hand edit of the same text, so it is a DELTA refresh. The label is now `conflicts` in place of `merge-ready`. Merge `origin/main` into the branch, then ask for a delta review of the merge. Also check the project version: #2126 also takes v63.

The latest review on 75031d5f9 requested no changes. Its four nonblocking notes are unchanged.

Merged upstream/main to resolve the conflicts. The only manual conflict was in add_tool help text. Kept this PR's cutting-row description and main's Weldon-holder description. No executable logic was resolved by hand. PROCESS_VERSION, changelog files and PNGs match main.

Existing pins passed: cutting_unknown_row 9/9, tool_cutting_rows 11/11, holder_library 12/12, and mcp_holder 5/5. No new behavior fix required a mutation check.

cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passed with zero failures. Clippy on tools, app and UI passed for all targets with warnings denied.

Returned the PR to draft before pushing the merge. New head: af78aec60436e402c8e026d5bc9521552131bf5a.

Please re-review the conflict resolution. Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: af78aec60436e402c8e026d5bc9521552131bf5a -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change can alter posted spindle speeds and operation cutting steps.

What looks good:

- The manual merge resolution keeps the cutting-data description and the Weldon-holder description. It changes no executable logic.
- The migration, material selection, posted S/F words, and undo tests pass.
- The trial merge with upstream/main `4b7a6b1e87d3db22222ea3132f95a45f20a45f8a` is clean. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.
- Current main still writes project version 62. This PR writes version 63. There is no version collision with current main.
- The PR changes no golden files, snapshot PNGs, dependencies, build scripts, workflows, or process files.

Local results on Linux, after the trial merge:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tools lib | 84 passed |
| Tools `unknown_row`, `waterjet` | 6 passed each |
| App `commands_undo` | 30 passed |
| App `cutting_data`, `cutting_unknown_row` | 6 and 9 passed |
| App `holder_library`, `mcp_holder` | 12 and 5 passed |
| App `project_roundtrip`, `setup_delete_order` | 73 and 2 passed |
| App `tool_cutting_rows`, `tool_library`, `waterjet_machine` | 11, 14, and 13 passed |
| UI lib, from `crates/ui` | 932 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored |
| UI `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| Clippy, tools/app/UI, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |

The selected test targets compiled. No GitHub runner was used. Pixel snapshot tests were not run.

The UI failure is `egui_app::tests::stock_fit::stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_fit.rs:31`. The lookup finds two controls with the label `Delete`. The exact test fails again on the trial merge. It also fails with the same error on upstream/main alone. This is an inherited test failure.

Two mutation checks ran in a disposable copy. The contributor code was not changed:

1. Remove the `row_for` Unknown fallback. `the_named_row_wins_then_the_unknown_row_answers` fails: `None` instead of `Some(9000.0)`.
2. Remove the `steps_for` Unknown stepover fallback. `a_missing_step_falls_back_to_the_unknown_row` fails: `(Some(2.0), None)` instead of `(Some(2.0), Some(3.0))`.

The restored `unknown_row` suite passes all 6 tests.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs:57` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/stock_material_row.rs:21`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the cutting-data table and the stock Material control. The body currently has no screenshots and states that no hands-on UI run was done. This review requires screenshots for UI changes. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not add image files to this PR branch.

The PR stays a draft while this item is open. The four notes from the earlier review remain nonblocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Added before/after screenshots of the cutting-data table and stock Material control to the PR body. They are real headless egui renders of the shipping controls, from pre-feature 31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239 and reviewed head af78aec60436e402c8e026d5bc9521552131bf5a. The four PNGs are stored only on the fork's images-only pr-screenshots branch at b8e36213fceb86370d85ace7865d5ac48ddf1c4d.

Both capture checks passed at each revision. The screenshot-link pin verified four distinct, accessible PNGs at immutable URLs. Removing one link from a local body copy made it fail; restoring it passed. No product code, capture harness, screenshots, or review evidence was committed to this PR branch.

Quick gate passed: cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main, zero failures. Clippy passed for camcraft-tools, camcraft-app, and camcraft-ui, all targets with warnings denied.

Head remains af78aec60436e402c8e026d5bc9521552131bf5a because this finding only required PR-body evidence. The PR remains a draft. Please re-review the screenshot finding.

Ready for the maintainer to merge at the next cut.

- I downloaded and inspected all four PNGs. The images show the fixed Unknown row, the step fields, and the Material group.
- The links use immutable commit `b8e36213fceb86370d85ace7865d5ac48ddf1c4d` on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
- This PR adds no screenshots, golden changes, dependencies, build scripts, workflows, or process changes.

The trial merge with current upstream/main `4b7a6b1e87d3db22222ea3132f95a45f20a45f8a` succeeds. The head and main match the earlier review. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.

This is a safety-tier review because cutting rows can change posted spindle speeds and operation cutting steps. Two mutations ran independently in a disposable copy:

1. Remove the `row_for` Unknown fallback. `the_named_row_wins_then_the_unknown_row_answers` fails: `None` instead of `Some(9000.0)`.
2. Remove the `steps_for` Unknown stepover fallback. `a_missing_step_falls_back_to_the_unknown_row` fails: `(Some(2.0), None)` instead of `(Some(2.0), Some(3.0))`.

The baseline and restored `unknown_row` suite each pass all 6 tests. No contributor code was changed. There are no moved goldens to inspect.

No GitHub runner was used. Pixel snapshot tests were not run. The full UI suite was not repeated for this evidence-only re-review. The earlier review records the inherited `stock_fit` duplicate-Delete failure on upstream/main. The earlier nonblocking notes remain unchanged.

Requested before merge: none. The screenshot finding is resolved.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fact for the record: the commits of this PR are in `main` now. PR #2101 was stacked on this branch, and its merge commit `c3c9f9a3a` (2026-11-16, merged by the NeoTech session) carried them in. Only the merge commit `af78aec60` of this branch is not in `main`.

- The merging session did not see that #2101 was a stacked child. That is our error, not the author's.
- This PR is a `feat!`. Its last review on head `af78aec60` reads "Ready for the maintainer to merge at the next cut". The NeoTech lane made no review of it.
- The post-merge audit of #2101 built and tested the landed tree (geometry, sim, app, ui, tools, clippy): all green.
- The next release notes must list this change as breaking (project file format, cutting data by work material, posted spindle speeds).

This PR can be closed as "work done in `c3c9f9a3a`". The maintainer decides if he wants a second safety-floor review of the landed change first.

The latest review on af78aec60436e402c8e026d5bc9521552131bf5a requests no changes. It confirms that the screenshot finding is resolved.

The PR still had the conflicts label. I merged upstream/main locally without conflicts or hand edits. The resulting tree matches upstream/main exactly. The merge has no remerge diff. No behavior fix or mutation check was required.

The quick gate passed with zero selected test steps. Clippy failed with E0063 at crates/app/tests/stock_in_vise_sim.rs:103. The LocateSpec initializer has no body field. This error is in the tree that matches upstream/main.

I stopped before pushing because this error is outside the review findings. The remote head remains af78aec60436e402c8e026d5bc9521552131bf5a. The local merge is 4dabb0e3708beddedd49141aee2103dab2aa53f2 on branch fix-2077.

I returned the PR to draft as required before the planned push. No labels were changed. Please re-review after the upstream compile error is fixed.

New head: 9deee33226f4fc6a0ede78699f8bd4e854b2aaea. The PR remains a draft. No labels were changed.

Please re-review the main merge. Ready for a re-check.

Flagged ready. Since the reviewed head `af78aec6` the only commit is `9deee332`, a merge of main with no hand edits: `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2077 --reviewed af78aec6` says SAME, so the review stands. This is a breaking `feat!`: it merges at the next cut.
